name: personal-skills
description: A repo-agnostic workflow library for Claude Code, built around one front door. /orchestrate ensures a corpus/ workspace exists, reads corpus/routing.md, classifies the request, and routes it: capture to corpus-flow (an LLM-maintained project wiki + todos-to-briefs-to-done lifecycle), build to plan-split-dispatch (model-routed subagent implementation — opus plans, splits and verifies; sonnet executes chunks by default, opus takes the novel or risky ones), questions to the wiki. Around that core: corpus-docs-site scaffolds a Starlight docs site over a corpus-flow project, rendering the narrative from the corpus wiki and generating the API reference from the TypeScript (Compodoc or TypeDoc) as one monorepo task. init-personal-repo wires a repo into the workflow by idempotently adding a delimited managed block to the repo-root CLAUDE.md — additions only, never rewriting your own content. A research and understanding trio: web-research (sourced, fact-checked reports; searches run inline for token efficiency, subagents only for code exploration), codegraph (graph-first, grep-verified code understanding — impact, blast radius, rename safety), and performance-analysis (measure a live page with Chrome DevTools MCP, then rank fixes by measured impact). Plus grill-me (interview-style plan stress-testing), ui-test-plans (plain-text UI test plans and a Playwright run-hub), and bootstrap-vps-deploy (a zero-dependency static-client and pm2-service deploy behind Caddy). Together: grilled briefs and a curated wiki for quality, model-routed dispatch and scoped context for token efficiency, one front door for UX.
